0,0.description: repaint this isometric tycoon game map of part of the United States, keeping every coastline, river, road, mountain, forest, field, town and city exactly where it is and in the same highly detailed HD painterly pixel art shading with layered depth, warm late-afternoon light and a saturated palette, changing only the season to autumn: the eastern and northern woods in red, orange and gold, harvested brown and gold fields, low amber light, the first snow on the high peaks. Never write any words, names, letters or labels anywhere on the map. The cities in this part of the map keep their landmarks: Seattle with the Space Needle, ferries on Puget Sound, port cranes and Mount Rainier behind; Oakland and San Francisco with the Bay Bridge, the Golden Gate Bridge, the Transamerica Pyramid and port cranes; Denver with the Rockies behind it, Union Station and the cash-register building; Las Vegas with the Strip's casino towers, the Stratosphere, the Sphere and neon; Salt Lake City with temple spires under the Wasatch and the Great Salt Lake; Portland with the St. Johns Bridge and Mount Hood behind; Fresno with a water tower among orchards and vineyards under the Sierra; Stockton with its inland port and delta waterways.
